verdict.rationale: Firstbase is an incorporation and back-office platform, and such platforms plausibly handle signing of formation documents, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about e-signatures, audit trails, tamper-evidence or completion certificates. The pack covers only registered agent, mailroom, banking, accounting and tax features.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can rely on a tamper-evident audit trail and completion certificate for every signed document
